title: A Spell Passed Down Through the Academy?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Is that really true? There's something that wondrous at the academy?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: I only just heard about it too, but apparently! They say it's a kind of happiness spell that's been passed down through generations of students at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: So let's get going! I wanna find out the truth about this!
choice_data_list: Sure, but where do we do that?
Sure, but where do we do that?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Good question! If it's a spell passed down person-to-person, that means someone must know it right now! So we gotta ask around!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: A legendary oral tradition, huh? ♪ Come to think of it, I've heard there's a sect of druids that pass on their teachings orally instead of through writing!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: We've already got some good info! Druidic teachings… How mysterious!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Apparently, it's been passed down deep within a forest. That must be useful for keeping it secret.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: We're off to the forest, then! Let's go, Familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: There's nothing here!
choice_data_list: Because we're in the wrong country… and century!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: A spell for happiness? Leave it to me! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: First, get some lip balm ready! Then push it out as far as you can…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Now, all I have to do is write your name on the stick and recite the spell as the sun sets…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Nothing happened! "A fateful moment of happiness" is supposed to "occur"! Doesn't that mean magic?!
choice_data_list: Uh… Why don't we head back? It's almost dinner time.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: No! I can't just give up if I know there's magic to be found!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I gotta learn a ton of spells if I want to be a great witch like Grandma!
choice_data_list: But we don't have any leads…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ngh… But I wanna know the happiness spell!
Exquisite! Your thirst for knowledge is truly admirable!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: So you're the one who's been asking around about the academy's happiness spell!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm! It's a spell known by only a handful of people at the academy! For you to seek it so fervently that word of your efforts has reached my ears…

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Well, let's say I'm impressed! As a reward for all your efforts, I shall entrust you with the secret of the spell!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: …Here we are.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: If we recite the spell the director taught us here, some incredible magic should activate!
I got all the ingredients… Huh? What are you two doing here?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: The treasure ship transports joy.
…Well now. Are you prepared for the consequences of the words you've recited?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Uh, yeah!

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text: Here you are! Our secret menu item, the Hearty Treasure Ship Parfait!

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text: It was removed from the menu for budgetary reasons, so now it's only passed down to those who truly desire the biggest dessert at all costs…

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text: It's like a forbidden spell! I'm surprised anyone still knows about it. ♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: S-so this is the result of the magic?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After all that frantic searching, it turns out the spell was just a password for a secret menu item! She's going to throw a tantrum!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Chomp!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Oooh! It's sooo good!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: This is great! A random dessert right out of nowhere!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: This was so worth it. You don't find amazing spells like this every day!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: This is exactly why I can't stop searching for new spells! This magical parfait is the best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I thought she was going to say it isn't magical at all… but it seems like she has a much more broad and optimistic view of magic than I realized.
choice_data_list: It really was a happiness spell!
It really was a happiness spell!
Maybe I should try it too.
Maybe I should try it too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I thought she was going to say it isn't magical at all… but it seems like she has a much more broad and optimistic view of magic than I realized.
choice_data_list: It really was a happiness spell!
It really was a happiness spell!
Maybe I should try it too.
Maybe I should try it too.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that's right. You get it, Familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: All righty, now to dig in! I'm gonna eat every last bite!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't help but smile, seeing her get so excited over her giant dessert.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ha! Look at you, a mere familiar thinking you can use forbidden spells!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: But… maybe I can allow it once in a while. You did help me find it, after all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After that, I often catch sight of Sweep Tosho in the cafeteria, proudly casting her spell.
